description: Baidu AI Cloud (百度智能云) is the cloud arm of Baidu, Inc., headquartered in Beijing, China. Its speech technology service sells short, realtime and file speech recognition (including a large-model ASR), text-to-speech voice tiers, large-model voice cloning, call-center telephony speech and an end-to-end realtime speech-language model, priced in CNY. Accounts require Chinese real-name verification.
name: Baidu AI Cloud Speech
